purpose: WAVE 5. The variations wave 4's adversarial critic (F1) used to show that the dead-band boundary printed by wave 3 -- tau > b/2 -- is the NULL-SCORECASTER special case and not the law. The law is tau* = sup_x r_t(x) + sup_t qhat_t - b/2. These runs exist so that every number the paper prints about those variations traces to results/ and comes from committed code.
boundary_law: tau* = sup_x r_t(x) + sup_t qhat_t - b/2 ; coverage lost for tau > tau*
